result.reasoning_summary: Commit implements FW-HARNESS-007 Azure Foundry exact-commit reviewer with all required safety controls: (1) Endpoint validation enforces approved Azure HTTPS routes (openai.azure.com or services.ai.azure.com) and OpenAI v1 base route; (2) Transient Entra token obtained via az CLI, held only in request header, never persisted; (3) Exact job_id and commit SHA validated via strict schema binding before returning result; (4) Resource bounds enforced: 90s timeout, 2MB response, 4000 completion tokens, 48KB prompt; (5) Snapshot parameter unused and output marked advisory with no repository/tool/deployment authority; (6) Credit guard is comprehensive: denies before credential resolution via atomic file-locked reservation; requires recent (900s max staleness) unexpired credit-only spending-protected evidence; reserves worst-case per-call cost, maintains 100 USD reserve, caps daily calls at 20; (7) Missing Azure config becomes unavailable rather than errors; (8) Secrets redacted in all error paths; (9) No live resource created or paid call made by design. Tests: 29 focused pass; comprehensive coverage of v1 route, Entra auth, schema validation, endpoint allowlist, credit guard edge cases, worst-case reservation, daily limits, malformed output rejection, and credential redaction. Patch is deterministic, narrow, and production-ready for the gated live-call phase.
